steps.title: Keep your permitted copy and edition
steps.instruction: Use an existing permitted Windows Standard or Lite copy. Keep the edition you already use when updating: upstream says Standard and Lite can use different data directories. The reviewed Windows Lite ZIP contains pvzge-lite.exe; keep your complete copy in a folder you control. Follow the upstream guide for package prerequisites. Portcove does not open the game or a helper during discovery.

steps.title: Add the game you chose
steps.instruction: Select the completed game executable from that folder, with the same folder as its working directory; for Windows Lite this is pvzge-lite.exe. Save launch details, then choose Play separately. Keep the working copy until you have checked the new one. macOS packages and Linux Docker/browser play retain their upstream setup routes; this Windows archive observation does not qualify their execution.

steps.title: Export saves before updating and keep mod data
steps.instruction: You or upstream provide runtime updates. In the game, select your player name to export a save before changing versions, and verify your progress in the new version before removing the old package. For mods, use Mods → Open Folder to locate the directory used by your edition. Close the game before copying mod-data, relevant mod settings, patches, __gpn_edits and save-backups; exported game saves and cloud saves do not automatically include mod-owned data. Follow GP-Next recovery instructions for startup or mod problems. External registration preserves every file and provides no Portcove-managed Update, Backup or Rollback.
